details: A set is shattered exactly when it becomes strongly shattered in its coordinate projection.
proof: A set $S$ is shattered by $\mathcal H$ exactly when the projection $\mathcal H_{|S}$ contains the full $S$-cube. In that projection, $S$ is strongly shattered. Conversely, a strongly shattered set in any projection is shattered by the original class on the same coordinates. Taking maxima yields equality.
name: Projected Strongly Shattered Dimension / VC Dimension
